lead.headline: TSMC posts a record quarter — and triggers a selloff
lead.dek: Record Q2 revenue with capex lifted to $60–64B; the Nasdaq falls 1.47% as AI-chip fatigue sets in.
body: TSMC's blowout quarter came with a 2026 capex raise that markets read as a warning about spending discipline across the AI build-out. The result: a second-day chip selloff that dragged the broader index down sharply.
lead.whyItMatters: Capex raises used to be bullish signals. The reaction function has flipped.

stories.headline: Google model report roils the AI trade
stories.dek: A Bloomberg report added fuel to the de-rating.
body: A Bloomberg report on Google's model strategy compounded the risk-off tone in AI names through the session.
stories.whyItMatters: Narrative risk is now a bigger daily driver than earnings for the AI complex.

picks.reason: High-conviction hold through the capex scare; demand signals intact.
Record quarter; selloff read as positioning, not fundamentals.
Capex hikes across the fab complex flow straight to equipment makers.
